title: Part 6 段落填空
goal: 上下文衔接、连接副词、句子插入

steps.title: Part 6 是什么样的题
lines: Dear Mr. Ford, our records show that invoice #2280 is now thirty days overdue.
福特先生：我们的记录显示，第 2280 号发票已逾期三十天。
___, we have not received any reply to our last two reminders. (A) Therefore (B) In addition (C) Instead (D) For example
___，我们前两次催款也没有收到任何回复。
Answer: (B) In addition — the sentence adds a second problem.
答案 B：这句是在“再加一个问题”。
Please contact our accountant to arrange payment in installments if necessary.
如有需要，请联系我们的会计安排分期付款。
steps.note: Part 6 有 4 篇短文（邮件、通知、广告、文章），每篇 4 个空、共 16 题。和 Part 5 的区别：答案要看前后句，只看一句常常两个选项都对。

steps.title: 连接副词：看前后两句是什么关系
what: 递进（再加一点）：In addition / Furthermore / Moreover / Also
转折（但是）：However / Nevertheless / Even so / On the other hand
因果（所以）：Therefore / As a result / Consequently / Accordingly
时间：Meanwhile（同时）/ Subsequently（随后）/ Afterward / In the meantime
其他：For example（举例）/ Instead（反而）/ Otherwise（否则）/ In fact（事实上）
why: Part 6 每篇几乎都有一题连接副词。四个选项分属不同类型，只要判断出前后两句的关系就能选。
判断方法：把两句话用中文“而且 / 但是 / 所以 / 否则”连一下，哪个通顺就是哪一类。
zh: 中文的“然而”“因此”在书面语里也有，但中文常常不写连接词，靠意思连；英语书面语几乎每段都靠它们衔接，读的时候要把它们当“路标”。
ex: The audit took two weeks. As a result, the report was delayed.
审计用了两周，因此报告推迟了。
The new system is cost-effective. In addition, it is easy to use.
新系统很划算，而且易于使用。
Please submit your receipts by Friday. Otherwise, we cannot reimburse you.
请在周五前提交收据，否则我们无法给您报销。
err: Our funding was cut. Therefore, the project continued.
Our funding was cut. However, the project continued.
前后是转折，不是因果
Payment is overdue. For example, please pay today.
Payment is overdue. Therefore, please pay today.
前因后果用 Therefore
steps.sum: 把前后两句用中文连起来：而且 → In addition；但是 → However；所以 → Therefore；否则 → Otherwise。

drill.q: The fiscal year ends in March. ___, all expense reports must be submitted by March 15.
We usually pay by check. ___, this transaction will be made by wire transfer.
Please keep all your receipts. ___, you will not be reimbursed.
The renovation will take three weeks. ___, staff will work from the second floor.

steps.title: 连接副词不是连词：注意标点
what: 连接副词（However, Therefore…）不能把两个句子连成一句。正确写法：句号 + However, 或 分号 ; however,
真正的连词（but, so, although, because）才能直接连两个句子：…, but… / …, so…
Part 6 有时四个选项里同时有 However 和 Although：空格后面是逗号 + 句子、且前面是句号 → 选副词；空格把两个分句连在一句里 → 选连词。
why: 这是写作和 Part 6 共同的考点。“The invoice is overdue, however we…” 在正式英语里是错的（逗号接句）。
zh: 中文逗号可以一直连下去（“发票逾期了，然而我们……”），英语不行，然而 = However 前面要句号或分号。
ex: The payment was late; however, no fee was charged.
付款晚了，但没有收滞纳金。
The payment was late, but no fee was charged.
付款晚了，但没有收滞纳金。
Although the payment was late, no fee was charged.
虽然付款晚了，但没有收滞纳金。
err: The invoice is overdue, however we will wait one more week.
The invoice is overdue. However, we will wait one more week.
However 前用句号或分号
However the budget was small, we finished the project.
Although the budget was small, we finished the project.
连接两个分句用连词 Although
steps.sum: 句号 + However,；; however,；连两个分句用 but / although。

drill.q: ___ the audit found no problems, the company decided to change its accounting software.
The remittance arrived late. ___, the order was shipped on time.

drill.zh: 付款晚了；但是，没有收滞纳金。
a: The payment was late; however, no fee was charged.
The payment was late. However, no late fee was charged.
The payment was late; however, no late fee was charged.

steps.text: The audit took two weeks. As a result, the report was delayed.
steps.zh: 审计用了两周，因此报告推迟了。
steps.focus: As a result 后稍停；audit 重音在 AU

steps.q: Our ___ will review the documents before the meeting.
Payment can be made in three monthly ___.
The company will ___ travel expenses within two weeks.
Using e-mail instead of mail is a ___ way to contact customers.
The project received ___ from the city government.
Your account is two months ___. Please pay immediately. (逾期)
a: overdue

steps.a: Please keep all your receipts for reimbursement.
steps.zh: 请保留所有收据以便报销。

steps.a: Our records show that the invoice is now thirty days overdue.

steps.zh: 审计用了两周，因此报告推迟了。
a: The audit took two weeks. As a result, the report was delayed.
The audit took two weeks. Therefore, the report was delayed.
The audit took two weeks, so the report was delayed.

points: 重点：看前后两句关系 —— 递进 In addition / 转折 However / 因果 Therefore / 否则 Otherwise / 同时 Meanwhile。
重点：连接副词不能用逗号连句：句号 + However, 或 ; however,；连分句用 but / although。

steps.title: “it” 指什么？
lines: Thank you for your interest in our new line of merchandise.
感谢您关注我们的新系列商品。
___ will be available in all retail stores from June 1. (A) It (B) They (C) Them (D) Its
___将从 6 月 1 日起在所有零售店有售。
Answer: (B) They — the subject refers to the products in the new line, which are plural.
答案 B：指的是新系列里的各种商品，复数主语用 They。
A promotional brochure is enclosed. ___ includes a coupon for 10% off. (A) It (B) They (C) This (D) These
随信附上宣传册，___里有一张九折优惠券。
steps.note: Part 6 的代词题，答案不在空格所在的句子，而在前一两句的名词。先往回找，再看单复数、人还是物、作主语还是宾语。

steps.title: 代词：往前找名词，再定单复数和格
what: ① 往前找它指的名词：一样东西 → it / its；几样东西或几个人 → they / their / them
② 人还是物：customer → he / she / they；company → it（美式英语里公司是单数 it）
③ 位置决定“格”：主语 they / 宾语 them / 名词前 their / 单独作名词 theirs
why: Part 6 的代词选项通常是 it / they / them / its 或 he / his / their：四个都可能语法正确，只有和前文名词对上的那个才对。
zh: 中文“它”“它们”经常省略，中国学生写英语也常忘了代词要和前文一致，例如把 company 说成 they 又说成 it。
ex: Our retail partners have been very supportive. We thank them for their help.
我们的零售合作伙伴一直很支持，感谢他们的帮助。
The company changed its logo last year.
公司去年更换了标志。
The flyers are ready. Please distribute them at the entrance.
传单准备好了，请在入口处发放。
err: The company announced their new slogan.
The company announced its new slogan.
company 是单数 → its
We printed 500 flyers and gave it to customers.
We printed 500 flyers and gave them to customers.
flyers 复数 → them
steps.sum: 往前找名词 → 单数 it / its，复数 they / them / their；公司用 it。

drill.q: Ms. Diaz sent the brochures this morning. Please check ___ for errors before Friday.
Brightline Inc. has redesigned ___ website.
Our customers are important to us. That is why we always read ___ testimonials carefully.

steps.title: this / these + 名词：总结前文
what: This / These + 名词 用来概括前一句的整件事：We will lower prices. This change will…
名词常是“总结词”：this change / this offer / this decision / these measures / this approach
选项里有 this offer / this change / these products 时，看前一句说的是“一个优惠”“一个变化”还是“几样产品”。
why: 这种“总结名词”是 Part 6 的高频题：四个选项是四个不同名词，只有一个能概括前文。
zh: 中文“这一举措”“此次变动”也是一样的概括方式，英语要注意 this + 单数 / these + 复数。
ex: Prices will rise by 5% in July. This increase is due to higher shipping costs.
七月起价格上涨 5%，这次涨价是因为运费上涨。
Members get free delivery and early access to sales. These benefits are not available to other customers.
会员享受免运费和提前参加促销。这些福利其他顾客没有。
err: We will move to a new office. These changes will begin in May.
We will move to a new office. This change will begin in May.
前文只有一件事 → this change
This coupons can be used online.
These coupons can be used online.
复数名词用 these
steps.sum: This / These + 总结名词 概括前一句：先看前文是一件事还是几件事、是什么性质。

drill.q: We will offer free gift wrapping during December. ___ is available at all locations.
Our wholesale customers can now order online and pay later. ___ will make ordering much easier.

steps.text: A promotional brochure is enclosed. It includes a coupon for ten percent off.
steps.zh: 随信附上宣传册，里面有一张九折优惠券。

steps.q: Our new ___ “Fresh Every Day” appears on all our packaging.
This ___ is valid for 20% off any item in the store.
We sell to stores at ___ prices, and they sell to customers at retail prices.
The ___ we are targeting is people aged 25 to 40.
A large ___ beside the highway advertises the new mall.
Customer ___ on our website say the service is excellent. (推荐语，复数)
a: testimonials

steps.a: The company changed its logo last year.
A promotional brochure is enclosed with this letter.

steps.zh: 这些商品将从 6 月 1 日起在所有零售店有售。
a: These products will be available in all retail stores from June 1.
This merchandise will be available in all retail stores from June 1.
The merchandise will be available in all retail stores starting June 1.

points: 重点：代词往前找名词 —— 单数 it / its，复数 they / them / their，公司用 it。
重点：This / These + 总结名词（this change / these benefits）概括前文。

steps.title: 同一句，两种时态
lines: Last month, Hanson Corporation completed its acquisition of a small software company.
上个月，汉森公司完成了对一家小软件公司的收购。
The new subsidiary ___ its first product next spring. (A) launched (B) has launched (C) will launch (D) was launched
这家新子公司___明年春天推出首款产品。
Answer: (C) will launch — "next spring" is in the future.
答案 C：next spring 是将来。
Shareholders ___ the merger at a meeting on May 4. (A) approve (B) approved (C) will approve (D) are approving
股东们___在 5 月 4 日的会议上批准了合并。
Answer: It depends on when the article was written. Part 6 often gives this information in an earlier sentence.
答案要看文章写于什么时候——Part 6 往往在前文给出这个信息。
steps.note: Part 5 的时态题看同一句里的时间词；Part 6 的时态题，时间线索常在别的句子里：邮件日期、前文的 last week / next month、整篇在讲已发生还是将发生。

steps.title: Part 6 时态：先定整篇的时间线
what: ① 看文章类型和日期：邀请函、预告 → 事情还没发生（will / be going to）；报道、感谢信 → 已经发生（过去时）
② 看前一句和后一句的动词：前文 was announced / held，空格多半也是过去
③ 新闻导语常用现在完成时宣布刚发生的事：Hanson Corporation has acquired …，后面的细节用过去时
why: Part 6 的空格所在句子常常没有任何时间词，四个时态都语法正确，只有和全文时间线一致的那个才对。
zh: 中文不靠动词变形表时间，看文章时间线的习惯不强。读英文邮件时要先看日期和第一句，建立“现在是什么时候”的意识。
ex: Thank you for attending our press conference last Friday. The event was a great success.
感谢您上周五出席我们的新闻发布会，活动非常成功。
We are pleased to invite you to our annual shareholders' meeting. It will be held on June 2.
诚邀您参加年度股东大会，大会将于 6 月 2 日举行。
Ridge Foods has acquired a 30% stake in a local bakery. The deal was signed on Monday.
里奇食品已收购一家本地面包店 30% 的股份，协议于周一签署。
err: Thank you for attending our seminar yesterday. It will be a great success.
Thank you for attending our seminar yesterday. It was a great success.
事情已经发生
We invite you to our dinner next week. It was held at the Grand Hotel.
We invite you to our dinner next week. It will be held at the Grand Hotel.
邀请函 → 将来
steps.sum: 先看日期、文章类型、前后句动词，定好整篇时间线，再选时态。

drill.q: We are writing to invite you to our 50th anniversary dinner. The event ___ at the Plaza Hotel.
Thank you to everyone who came to last week's press conference. More than 200 reporters ___.
Ono Electronics ___ its subsidiary in Brazil. The sale was completed on Tuesday.

steps.title: 被动语态的时态：is being / has been / will be done
what: 一般：is / was done　进行：is being done　完成：has been done　将来：will be done
公告和新闻里大量用被动：The merger has been approved by the board of directors.
Part 6 常把时态和语态放在一起考：先判断主动被动，再按时间线选时态。
why: 被动的时态变化都在 be 身上：be 变成 is being / has been / will be，后面的过去分词不变。
zh: 中文“已经被批准”“正在被修理”“将被举行”，正好对应 has been approved / is being repaired / will be held。
ex: The new policy is being reviewed by the board.
新政策正在由董事会审议。
A dividend of $1.20 per share has been announced.
已宣布每股派息 1.20 美元。
The results will be announced in a press release.
结果将以新闻稿形式公布。
err: The offices are renovating now.
The offices are being renovated now.
办公室是被翻修的
The merger has approved by the board.
The merger has been approved by the board.
完成时的被动 has been done
steps.sum: 被动的时态都在 be 上：is being / has been / will be + done。

drill.q: The proposal ___ by the board of directors at this moment.
The details of the merger ___ in next week's press release.
A new spokesperson has ___ appointed. (be)
a: been

steps.text: Ridge Foods has acquired a thirty percent stake in a local bakery.
steps.zh: 里奇食品已收购一家本地面包店 30% 的股份。
steps.focus: acquired 重音在 quired；thirty percent 两处重读

steps.q: The two banks agreed to a ___ and will become one company.
The company announced the ___ of a smaller rival for $3 million.
All ___ will receive a copy of the annual report.
The firm owns a 25% ___ in the airline.
A company ___ said the store would reopen next week.
The ___ of directors meets four times a year.
a: board

steps.a: The merger has been approved by the board of directors.
The results will be announced in a press release.

steps.zh: 公司宣布每股派息一美元。
a: The company announced a dividend of one dollar per share.
The company has announced a dividend of one dollar per share.
The corporation announced a dividend of $1 per share.

points: 重点：Part 6 时态先定整篇时间线 —— 日期、文章类型、前后句动词。
重点：被动的时态都在 be 上：is being / has been / will be + done。

steps.title: 每篇必有一道的句子题
lines: We have upgraded our customer database. ___ As a result, you may need to reset your password.
我们升级了客户数据库。___ 因此，您可能需要重设密码。
(A) The new system is more secure than the old one.
（A）新系统比旧系统更安全。
(B) Our office will be closed on Monday.
（B）我们办公室周一休息。
(C) Thank you for your order.
（C）感谢您的订购。
Answer: (A) — it continues the topic of the upgrade and explains why passwords must be reset.
答案 A：它接着讲升级，又解释了为什么要重设密码。
steps.note: Part 6 每篇有一道“选一个句子填进空格”的题，共 4 题。四个句子单独看都通顺，要找的是和前后两句都接得上的那个。

steps.title: 句子插入的三种线索
what: ① 指代词：选项开头是 This / These / They / Such / It，前文必须有它能指的东西。（These devices are… → 前文要提到设备）
② 连接词：选项以 However / In addition / As a result 开头，要和前一句的关系对得上；空格后一句以 This / As a result 开头，空格句要给出它的原因或内容。
③ 关键词重复或换说法：空格句和前后句讲同一件事（upgrade → the new system）。
why: 四个选项通常一个完全无关（话题不同）、一个时态或指代不对、一个和前文矛盾，只有一个前后都能接上。
zh: 中文作文讲“承上启下”，就是这个意思：英语的承上启下靠指代词和连接词，有明确的形式线索。
ex: We will install wireless routers on every floor. ___ These devices will double our bandwidth.
我们会在每层安装无线路由器。（这些设备将使带宽翻倍。）
The software is easy to use. In addition, a free tutorial is available online.
这款软件很好用。此外，网上有免费教程。
err: We will upgrade our laptops. This printer is broken.
We will upgrade our laptops. The new models are faster and lighter.
插入句要接着讲同一件事
steps.sum: 插入句要承上（指代词、关键词）也要启下（后一句的 This / As a result 有着落）。

drill.q: Our new app is now available. ___ Simply follow the steps in the video to get started. —— Which sentence fits?
o: The app was not popular last year.
A short tutorial is included with the app.

drill.q: The prototype passed all safety tests. ___ We expect to begin production in March. —— Which sentence fits?
o: It also met every design specification.
However, it failed the safety tests.

drill.q: Please make sure your computer is compatible with the new software. ___ —— Which sentence fits?
o: The software was free last year.
Older models may not run it properly.
Our cafeteria serves lunch until two.
Thank you for attending the seminar.

steps.title: 排除法：三种错误选项
what: 话题无关：讲 IT 升级的邮件里突然出现“食堂菜单”。
指代对不上：选项说 These employees…，可前文没有提到任何员工；选项说 It…，前文却是复数名词。
时间线或逻辑矛盾：前文说升级下周进行，选项说 The upgrade was completed yesterday；前文说很成功，选项用 However 说很成功。
why: 先用排除法删掉两个明显错的，再在剩下两个里看谁和后一句接得上。
zh: 中国考生常选“意思最好、最像范文”的句子，其实要选“和这里的上下文接得上”的那个。
ex: The office will be closed for maintenance on Saturday. ___ (✓ All systems will be back online by Monday morning.)
办公室周六维护关闭。（所有系统将于周一上午恢复。）
err: The upgrade will start next week. The upgrade was finished yesterday.
The upgrade will start next week. It should take about three days.
时间线不能矛盾
steps.sum: 删掉话题无关、指代不对、时间矛盾的，再看谁和后一句接得上。

drill.q: We are going to automate our ordering system next month. ___ Staff will therefore have more time to help customers. —— Which sentence fits?
o: This will reduce the time spent on paperwork.
The system was automated last year.

drill.q: Technicians will configure the new laptops on Thursday. ___ —— Which sentence does NOT fit?
o: The process should take about an hour.
Please leave your old laptop on your desk.
You will receive your laptop on Friday.
drill.e: 前文说周四才配置，They were configured last month 时间矛盾。

steps.text: We will install wireless routers on every floor. These devices will double our bandwidth.
steps.zh: 我们会在每层安装无线路由器，这些设备将使带宽翻倍。
steps.focus: These devices 重读，表示“承上”

steps.q: Our ___ contains information on more than 10,000 customers.
This printer is not ___ with older computers.
The engineers built a ___ to test the new design.
The website is very ___, so even beginners can use it easily.
The lab uses ___ technology that most companies do not have yet.
We need more ___ to stream video during the webinar. (带宽)
a: bandwidth

steps.a: A free tutorial is available online.
We have upgraded our customer database.

steps.zh: 技术人员周四会配置新电脑。
a: Technicians will configure the new computers on Thursday.
The technicians will configure the new laptops on Thursday.
Technicians will set up the new computers on Thursday.

points: 重点：句子插入三线索 —— 指代词（This / These）、连接词、关键词重复或换说法。
重点：排除法 —— 删话题无关、指代不对、时间矛盾的选项，再看谁和后一句接得上。

steps.title: 一篇完整的 Part 6
lines: Dear Ms. Grant, thank you for renting an office at Lakeview Tower for the past two years.
格兰特女士：感谢您过去两年在湖景大厦租用办公室。
Your current lease ___ on August 31. (A) expired (B) will expire (C) has expired (D) expiring
您目前的租约将于 8 月 31 日___。
If you wish to renew it, please sign the enclosed form. ___, we will assume you plan to move out. (A) Otherwise (B) Therefore (C) In addition (D) For example
如果您想续租，请签署随附表格。___，我们将视为您计划搬走。
Answers: (B) will expire, because the letter is sent before August; (A) Otherwise, which means "if you don't sign".
答案：B（信寄出时还没到 8 月）；A（否则 = 如果不签）。
steps.note: Part 6 一篇 4 题：通常 1 题连接词、1 题时态或代词、1 题词汇、1 题句子插入。这一课把它们放进一篇合同类的信里练。

steps.title: Part 6 的做题顺序
what: ① 从头往下读，读到空格就做：语法题（时态、代词、词性）大多看前后一两句就能做。
② 遇到句子插入题，先跳过，把全文读完再回来 —— 它最需要上下文。
③ 词汇题（四个意思不同的词）：先看搭配，再看上下文；两个都通顺时，看文章的整体意思（续租的信里选 renew，不选 terminate）。
时间：一篇控制在 2 分钟左右，四篇约 8 分钟，把时间留给 Part 7。
why: Part 6 是 Part 5（语法词汇）和 Part 7（阅读）的结合，所以既要 Part 5 的速度，也要 Part 7 的“看上下文”。
zh: 中国考生容易在 Part 6 逐句翻译，速度太慢。要把它当“带上下文的 Part 5”来做。
ex: Your lease will expire on August 31. If you wish to renew it, please sign the enclosed form.
您的租约将于 8 月 31 日到期。如果您想续租，请签署随附表格。
In accordance with the terms of the lease, rent must be paid by the fifth of each month.
根据租约条款，房租须在每月 5 日前支付。
err: 先把四篇的句子插入题都做完，再回头做语法题。
Answer the grammar questions as you read, and do the sentence insertion question last.
语法题读到就做，句子插入题最后做
steps.sum: 读到空格就做语法题 → 句子插入留到最后 → 词汇题看全文意思；一篇约 2 分钟。

drill.q: Part 6 一篇的四道题里，最应该放到最后做的是：
This letter is to confirm that your lease has been ___ for another year. Your new contract starts on September 1.
drill.e: 后一句说新合同开始 → 续租 renewed。

steps.title: 合同和规定里的固定说法
what: be eligible for + 名词 / be eligible to do：有资格（申请、享受）
be entitled to + 名词：有权享有（a refund, two weeks of vacation）
in accordance with（按照、依据）· regardless of（不管、不论）· with regard to（关于）
be responsible for / be liable for：负责、负有（法律）责任
why: 这些短语在 Part 5、6、7 都高频，而且常考介词：eligible for、entitled to、in accordance with、regardless of。
zh: 中文“有资格”“有权”“按照”“不论”后面直接接名词；英语每个都带固定介词，一个都不能错。
ex: Full-time employees are eligible for health insurance.
全职员工有资格享受医疗保险。
Customers are entitled to a full refund within 30 days.
顾客 30 天内有权获得全额退款。
All visitors must sign in, regardless of the purpose of their visit.
无论来访目的为何，所有访客都必须登记。
err: Part-time staff are eligible to the bonus.
Part-time staff are eligible for the bonus.
eligible for + 名词
In accordance to the contract, we will pay within 30 days.
In accordance with the contract, we will pay within 30 days.
in accordance with
steps.sum: eligible for · entitled to · in accordance with · regardless of · with regard to。

drill.q: Employees who have worked here for a year are ___ for a promotion.
Tenants are ___ to one parking space each.
The building will be inspected in accordance ___ city regulations.
a: with

drill.q: I am writing ___ regard to your recent inquiry.

steps.text: In accordance with the terms of the lease, rent must be paid by the fifth of each month.
steps.zh: 根据租约条款，房租须在每月 5 日前支付。
steps.focus: accordance 重音在 cor；lease /liːs/ 是清音 s

steps.q: Please read the ___ and conditions carefully before signing.
A ___ in the contract says that the rent may increase each year.
Only the manager can ___ payments over $5,000.
The company accepts no ___ for items left in the lockers.
You are under no ___ to buy anything at the event.
The fee is the same ___ of the size of the room.

steps.a: Your current lease will expire on August 31.
steps.zh: 您目前的租约将于 8 月 31 日到期。

steps.a: Customers are entitled to a full refund within thirty days.

steps.zh: 如果您想续租，请签署随附的表格。
a: If you wish to renew your lease, please sign the enclosed form.
If you want to renew the lease, please sign the enclosed form.
If you would like to renew your lease, please sign the attached form.

points: 合同词：lease、terms、renew、clause、liability、obligation、authorize、be eligible for、be entitled to、in accordance with、regardless of、with regard to。
重点：Part 6 做题顺序 —— 读到空格就做语法题，句子插入留到最后，词汇题看全文意思。
重点：eligible for / entitled to / in accordance with / regardless of / with regard to。
单元总结：连接副词看关系 → 代词往前找 → 时态看全文时间线 → 句子插入看承上启下。

lessons.title: 单元阅读：Memo: New Expense System

steps.title: Memo: New Expense System
steps.note: Part 6 式的公司备忘录：读的时候圈出连接副词（However / In addition / As a result）和代词（it / they / this），想一想它们各连着哪一句。
lines: To: All Staff
收件人：全体员工
From: Paul Meyer, Finance Department
发件人：财务部保罗·迈耶
Subject: New expense system
主题：新的报销系统
Following the merger with Delta Logistics last spring, our two companies have been using different accounting software.
自去年春天与达美物流合并以来，我们两家公司一直在使用不同的会计软件。
This has made it difficult to track transactions across departments.
这使得跨部门追踪交易变得困难。
As a result, the board of directors has approved a new online expense system.
因此，董事会批准了一个新的在线报销系统。
The system will be launched on October 1. It is user-friendly and compatible with all company laptops.
该系统将于 10 月 1 日上线。它易于使用，并与公司所有笔记本电脑兼容。
In addition, receipts can be uploaded with a phone camera, so paper copies will no longer be required.
此外，收据可以用手机拍照上传，因此不再需要纸质副本。
Staff who submit their reports through the system will be reimbursed within five days.
通过系统提交报告的员工将在五天内获得报销。
A short video tutorial is available on the company website. Please watch it before October 1.
公司网站上有一段简短的视频教程，请在 10 月 1 日前观看。
However, reports for September should still be submitted on the old forms.
不过，九月份的报告仍应使用旧表格提交。
Questions with regard to the new system can be sent to the finance team.
关于新系统的问题可以发给财务团队。

steps.q: Why is the company introducing a new system?
o: The two merged companies use different software.
The old system was too expensive.
steps.e: This has made it difficult… As a result… —— This 指前一句“用不同软件”。

steps.q: In paragraph 1, the word "This" refers to
o: the use of different accounting software
steps.e: 代词题：往前找它概括的那件事。

steps.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the new system?
o: It lets staff pay invoices automatically.
Receipts can be uploaded with a phone.
It works on all company laptops.

steps.q: What are staff asked to do before October 1?
steps.e: Please watch it before October 1. —— it = the video tutorial。

steps.q: Which sentence could best be added after "Staff who submit their reports through the system will be reimbursed within five days"?
o: This is ten days faster than the current process.
Our cafeteria will open at noon.
The merger took place in Chicago.
steps.e: 句子插入：接着讲“报销快”，This 承上。

steps.zh: 此外，不再需要纸质副本。
a: In addition, paper copies will no longer be required.
In addition, paper copies are no longer required.
Moreover, paper copies will no longer be needed.

points: 本单元重点都在文中：As a result / In addition / However（连接副词）、This / It（指代）、will be launched / has been approved（时态与被动）。
句子插入：选项开头的 This 要能指前一句的事。

extra.q: The invoice was due on May 1. ___, we have not yet received payment.

This will make it easier to find your order history.

extra.zh: 根据合同，我们将在 30 天内付款。
a: In accordance with the contract, we will pay within 30 days.
In accordance with the contract, we will make payment within 30 days.
